verdict.line: You lose if you let Yorick's grave count climb into a walker swarm before you commit; you win if you isolate him with E into Q before level 6.

brief.thesis: Yorick has almost no inherent lane pressure — his threat scales with Mist Walkers summoned from graves his Q (Last Rites) digs, so an early Yorick is just a melee auto-attacker. Gwen's Q (Snip Snip!) deals true damage to whatever is centered in its cone and her E (Skip 'n Slash) dash-reset lets her win a raw 1v1 before that swarm exists, which is exactly why the overall lane reads EVEN at 50.6% but the Gwen-vs-Yorick head-to-head sits at 57.3% over 626 games with the solo-kill edge on your side.

theirWindow.what: Once he's dug enough graves his walkers tank damage and chase marked targets faster, so he can trade into you with free bodies absorbing your Q hits and his W (Dark Procession) wall can box you against them — disengage rather than stand and trade here.

yourWindow.what: Dash in with E (Skip 'n Slash), land Q (Snip Snip!) so the true-damage center hits him, then auto to refresh E's cooldown and re-engage — he has no swarm to fall back on yet.

start.why: 92.5% pick at 57.4% win rate — the AP boosts your Q cone true-damage poke and the potions cover the chip damage from his empowered Q auto while you wait for walker count to stay at zero.

boots.why: Highest-winning boots option (63.1% over 293 games) — Yorick has no magic burst to dodge, so magic penetration into your Q/E damage matters more than the armor from Plated Steelcaps.

core.why: Core first item in the 65.5% win-rate path, builds your early skirmish damage into the level 6-8 window where you need to still threaten kills despite his walkers.
Second item in the same 29.4%-pick path — the burst amp converts your solo-kill advantage into actual kills before his swarm scales.
Final item of the top build path (65.5% WR, 145 games) — scales your true-damage Q and on-hit E once lane is decided.

situational.when: the game goes long and you need sustain through repeated walker-swarm skirmishes (61.9% WR alt path)
Yorick lands Eulogy of the Isles and you need to survive a Maiden-boosted dive
you're ahead and want to lean on attack speed on-hit from E rather than pure burst

runes.keystoneWhy: Run in both top win-rate pages (52% and 66.3% pick share) — stacks through your Q's six snips and E's on-hit window, rewarding the sustained skirmishes this matchup is built on.

summoners.why: Highest-performing combo in the data (56.4% WR, 68% pick) — Ignite punishes Yorick's Q (Last Rites) self-heal during your all-in window and converts your solo-kill advantage into secured kills before walkers exist.

playing.title: Punish before walkers stack
playing.detail: All-in with E (Skip 'n Slash) into Q (Snip Snip!) before level 6, while his grave count is still low — Yorick's lane presence is almost entirely dependent on walker numbers he hasn't built yet.

playing.title: Don't fight inside his wall
playing.detail: Yorick's W (Dark Procession) drops a destructible wall at 600 range on a 20-12s cooldown — if he places it mid-trade, break off or go around rather than getting boxed in with his walkers.

playing.title: Hide in your own mist
playing.detail: Pop W (Hallowed Mist) when he commits his empowered Q auto or throws E (Mourning Mist) — enemies outside the mist can't target you, so he has to walk in and expose himself to punish it.

playing.title: Confirm E before disengaging
playing.detail: Skip 'n Slash's cooldown (13/12.5/12/11.5/11s) partially refunds on a landed hit, so always land an auto before backing off — it lets you re-dash for a second trade he can't match without walkers.

playing.title: Count his graves
playing.detail: Every champion hit or kill from his Q (Last Rites) digs a grave that eventually becomes a Mist Walker — track this to know when the free-kill window closes, usually around level 6.

playing.title: Respect the armor-shred poke
playing.detail: His E (Mourning Mist) reduces armor and slows on an 8-12s cooldown — don't walk into auto range right after he throws it or you eat a free empowered Q auto on top of it.

playing.title: Convert kills into tempo
playing.detail: You hold the solo-kill edge in this matchup (57.3% WR, 626 games) — prioritize isolated skirmishes over passive farming so you hit Shadowflame and Rabadon's before his split-push wincon takes over post-13.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, boots, runes, summoners and the win-rate figures above are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the tactical reasoning connecting them to grave counts, walker timing, and wall/mist interactions is my own read of the ability kit, not sourced data.
